message: When the lights go out, it can feel a bit daunting at first, but I like to think of it as an opportunity for a cozy evening in! I found this great resource that offers some handy tips for navigating power outages. Whether it’s lighting some candles, enjoying a board game, or just snuggling up under a blanket, a blackout can be a little adventure at home. Have you ever turned a power outage into a fun family night?
